items.title: The Novel’s Extra
items.overview:
Wouldn’t it be a dream to wake up in a world of your own creation? For Kim Hajin, it’s nothing short of a nightmare. 

With no clue how or why he’s been transported into his web novel — as a mere extra, no less! — Hajin has little choice but to see his story through until the end. Lucky for him, as the author, he knows this perilous world like the back of his hand. 

But when discrepancies in the plot begin popping up left and right, Hajin soon realizes that things aren’t quite so simple, after all…

---

aliases: パーマン (藤子・F・不二雄大全集)
Perman (The Complete Works of Fujiko F. Fujio)
items.overview:
One day, ordinary elementary school student Mitsuo Suwa meets an alien in an empty lot, who appoints him as the hero of justice, "Perman No. 1"! Together with the chimpanzee No. 2, the tomboyish girl with an unknown identity No. 3, and reliable Osaka native No. 4, they save lives and fight evil!

The series gained huge popularity in the late 1960s in Weekly Shonen Sunday and educational magazines for different grades, and was continued in the 1980s with a new setting. This version includes all episodes, including early versions not available in the original volumes and the stories featuring Perman No. 5, as well as the magazine's feature pages and the bonus features on the back cover of the original comic.

items.overview:
Lady Elizabeth has her engagement annulled at a party by the crown prince, whose heart has moved on to another young noblewoman. She is then imprisoned in the dungeon over unjust accusations, and learns she has been betrayed by the country to which she has devoted everything...

At the peak of her frustration, Elizabeth finally decides to defect, with a grimoire holding hidden and formidable powers in hand!! She begins her new life and trade with the help of Viscount Lucas from the neighbouring country. With a fierce desire for revenge against her home country in her heart.

This Alluring Dark Elf has the Heart of a Middle-Aged Man!
items.overview: With no friends, family, or romance to speak of, Haruka has lived his life just going through the motions—until the day he awakens in the body of a beautiful, and womanly, dark elf! Suddenly, a world beyond his wildest imagination awaits, and uncontainable excitement races through him. There's just one problem: He gave up on putting himself out there a long time ago and has no idea how to strike up a conversation with other people. Teenagers and (other) women are certainly no exception. But with a bottomless well of mana and a ridiculously tough body to boot, Haruka won't let any overthinking get in the way this time. Little by little, the dark elf works past his (her) fears and self-doubt, forging deep bonds with precious new friends and growing together with them.

items.overview:
“If I had a second life, wouldn't I be able to aim to become a ‘hero’ again?”

Solfort Enuma is a veteran soldier who has spent over sixty years training to become a ‘hero’. He is an ordinary man with no talent, but he never gave up and continued to pursue his dream. One day, Solfort faced off against one of the ‘heroes’ he had always admired, but his sword failed to land a single blow and he met an unrewarding end… or so he thought, but when he woke up, he found himself reincarnated as a little girl!?

items.title: Shoujo Shuumatsu Ryoukou
items.overview:
Civilization is dead, but Chito and Yuuri are still alive. 
So they hop aboard their Kettenkrad motorbike and aimlessly wander the ruins of the world they once knew. 
Day after hopeless day, they look for their next meal and fuel for their ride. 
But as long as they are together, even an existence as bleak as theirs has a ray or two of sunshine in it, 
whether they're sucking down their fill of soup or hunting for machine parts to tinker with. 
The experiences and feelings these two girls share in a world full of nothing give them something to live for…  
  
---
- **Won the Seiun Award for Best Comic in 2019**

items.overview:
Love, friendship, and a glorious adolescence—that's what Hodoka Nanamura hoped for when he entered high school. But by his final year, he had none of it. Then, on the eve of graduation, he sacrifices himself to save his classmate, Sora Hanamitsuji, from on oncoming truck, ending his life... or so it should have. Instead, he and Hanamitsuji were both transported back in time to their first year of high school, just before the entrance ceremony. Though Nanamura resigned himself to reliving the same unremarkable, lonely high school years, Hanamitsuji swears that she'll drag him out of his loner lifestyle!

*Source: Manga UP! Global*
